faq: Which email tools do you work in?
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Shopify Email, Brevo and similar tools. We add content as drafts inside your account after you invite us as a user. We never need your password.
Will emails follow anti spam rules?
We write for people who agreed to hear from you, include clear unsubscribe and sender details, and avoid misleading subject lines. Rules vary by country, so check your list consent with your adviser.
Do you send the emails to my list?
No. We prepare drafts and flows for your approval. Sending stays with you, so a person at your business always makes the last decision about what reaches your customers.
Can you write in my brand voice?
Yes. Send a past email or two and your tone notes. We match your style and keep claims you can support. Premium also gives you a short guide to edit the copy yourself later.
desc:
Email campaign copy and flows drafted by Ecom Swift LLC give your list something worth opening. We write subject lines, preview text, body copy and button text, map the steps of welcome and cart flows, and load the drafts into your email tool unsent.

## What is email campaign copy and a flow?

Email campaign copy is the written content of a one-off email: subject line, preview text, body and button. A flow is a series of automatic emails that starts when a person does something, such as joining your list or leaving items in a cart. Both need clear writing, sensible timing and a simple next step for the reader.

## Why email earns its place in your marketing

Email reaches people who already know you. They signed up, bought or showed interest, so the message lands with an audience that is closer to a decision than a stranger on social media. A good email can bring someone back to a product, explain a new offer or remind a customer to finish a purchase.

The quality of the writing changes how many people open, read and click. A vague subject line is skipped, a long email loses the point and a weak button text leaves the reader unsure what happens next. Automatic flows add another benefit: once built, they work around the clock, so a new subscriber receives a sensible welcome even while you are busy. Outcomes depend on your list, offers and timing, and we do not promise a result.

## What a strong email set includes

- Several subject line options per email, so you can pick or test.
- Preview text that adds to the subject instead of repeating it.
- An opening line that gets to the point at once.
- One main message and one main action per email.
- Button text that says what the click does.
- Product details and offers that match what is in your store.
- A plain text version for email clients that need one.
- Timing between emails in a flow, plus rules for when someone should leave the flow.
- Wording reviewed for words that commonly trigger spam filters.
- Drafts loaded in your email platform as unsent templates, ready for review.

## How we work

We begin with your list, offers and brand voice. We draft the emails using AI tools for a first pass, and a person then rewrites, shortens and checks each one for tone, clarity and accuracy. For flows, we plan every step: the trigger, the order, the delay and the exit rule.

You receive the work inside your own email tool as drafts, so nothing is sent to your customers without you. The Basic package covers a few campaign emails with subject line options. Standard adds a five step welcome flow, timing and exit rules, extra campaigns and plain text versions. Premium adds cart and win-back flows, more campaigns, a subject line testing plan, a short guide for your own edits and a spam wording review.

We do not send the emails and we do not manage your list.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send only to people who agreed to hear from you.
- Include a visible unsubscribe link and your business address.
- Lead with what the reader gains.
- Preview each email on a phone before sending.
- Test one change at a time, such as the subject line.

**Avoid:**
- Writing in capital letters or stacking exclamation marks.
- Buying or borrowing a list.
- Sending the same message to everyone regardless of behavior.
- Fitting five offers into a single email.
- Running a flow that keeps emailing someone who has already bought.

## Who this service is for

This service suits a store with an email tool already connected and an empty flow section. It suits an owner who sends a newsletter when time allows and wants a steady schedule. It also suits a business whose list has gone quiet and needs a win-back sequence that sounds like a real person.

## What we need from you

Tell us which email platform you use, share your brand details, offers and any past emails you liked, and add us as a collaborator or team user with permission to create drafts. We never ask for your password. You review every draft in your own account and decide when to send.
